title: Combined guess-and-run machine
statement: Let $P$ and $Q$ be deterministic $k$-work-tape Turing machines over Booleans, with state types $S_P$ and $S_Q$. Choose a setup exit state $p_{m exit}$, a work tape $j$, and run states $q_{m entry}$, $q_{m acc}$, and $q_{m rej}$; the nondeterministic machine with states tagged by computation phase starts in $P$'s initial state in the setup phase and combines the phase machines with transitions at these designated states: it writes a bounded guessed block on tape $j$, skips past the following blank, rewinds that tape, runs $Q$ from $q_{m entry}$, and emits true at $q_{m acc}$ or false at $q_{m rej}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ and $Q$ are deterministic machines over Booleans with state types $S_P$ and $S_Q$
The setup and run state types have decidable equality
$p_{m exit}$ is a setup state
$j$ is one of the $k$ work tapes
$q_{m entry}$, $q_{m acc}$, and $q_{m rej}$ are run states
